reviews.comment: False positive: the flagged operands are bytes of pdfString ([]byte) widened to uint16/int32/uint32; lossless by type. Parsed numbers that are narrowed are bound-checked (FirstChar<=255, CID<=maxCID).
reviews.evidence: CodeQL reaches these sites through the pdfObj interface from ParseInt in the lexer; Go's types rule that path out. TestAnchosSimplesNoTruncanPrimerCodigo and TestMetricasCIDNoTruncanCodigos cover the narrowed values.

reviews.comment: False positive: RC4 is only used to READ legacy PDFs (revisions 2-4) as the PDF spec requires. The only writer, cifradorPDF, always emits AES-256 (V5/R6, AESV3).
reviews.evidence: rc4Aplicar is reached only from password checks for R2-R4 and from criptoPDF.aplicar on decryption; TestProtegerPDFSoloEscribeAES256 fails if writing ever stops using AES-256.

reviews.comment: False positive: this SHA-256 is a change-detection fingerprint of the locked slide content; huellaProtect strips password/hasPassword before hashing. Passwords use the OOXML KDF.
reviews.evidence: Passwords are derived by HashClave/derivarClaveOOXML (random 16-byte salt, 100000 SHA-512 rounds); TestHuellaProtectNoDependeDeLaContrasena fixes that the fingerprint ignores the password.

reviews.comment: False positive: the HTML is parsed with DOMParser into an inert document (no scripting or browsing context), only body.textContent is read, and it is inserted as plain text.
reviews.evidence: new DOMParser().parseFromString(b.html, 'text/html') never runs scripts or handlers or loads resources; the text is inserted with execCommand('insertText'), so nothing reaches a live DOM sink.

reviews.comment: False positive: an artificial-only e2e sends fixture ciphertext to a fixed local Synapse (127.0.0.1:18585). Room, token and Megolm body are validated and size-bound; the origin is asserted before the request.
reviews.evidence: The fixture is produced by the native test run itself (fixture.artificial is asserted); the PUT is the test's purpose: proving the server rejects pre-encrypted cache without local witnesses.
